32J8: I have found the Perfect Guru, through great good fortune; He has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and my mind has become quiet and tranquil. ||1||
Through the greatest good luck, I have obtained the Perfect Guru. who has given me God's Name, by which the mind has become tranquil.
YUZ6: O Lord, I am the slave of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
My pervading God, I am said to be the slave of the True Guru. Pause.
QTGT: My forehead has been branded with His brand; I owe such a great debt to the Guru.
On my brow the brand of being guru's slave is branded. A greatly accumulated debt, I owe to the Guru.
E08H: He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
he has done me much beneficence and benevolence, and has ferried me across the formidable and terrible ocean.
37GD: Those who do not have love for the Lord within their hearts, harbor only false intentions and goals.
They who have not God's love in their heart, hatch many false plots.
1PJ6: As paper breaks down and dissolves in water, the self-willed manmukh wastes away in arrogant pride. ||3||
As the paper is dissolved in water, so is an apostate wasted away in pride.
EB2W: I know nothing, and I do not know the future; as the Lord keeps me, so do I stand.
I know nothing of past, nor do I know anything regarding future. As god keeps me so do I stand.
TMJ0: For my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace; servant Nanak is Your obedient dog. ||4||7||21||59||
I am filled with shortcoming and mistakes. O my Guru, take pity on me. Servant Nanak is known as a dog of Yours.
4X6D: The body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.
with lust and wrath, the body village is full to the brim. By meeting the saint Guru I have broken both into pieces.
JCGC: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||
By virtue of the pre-ordained writ I have obtained the Guru and entered the realm of Lord's Love.
8V7B: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.
Make obeisance with joined hands to the Saint Guru.
MRJ6: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||
Make a prostrate salutation. This is a great virtue indeed. Pause.
B146: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the taste of the Lord's sublime essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.
The mammon worshipper knows not the relish of God's elixir; within him is the thorn, of pride.
1NWB: The more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||
The more he walks (away from God), the more it pricks, and more the pain he suffers, and he bears on his head the mace of Death's myrmidon.
K502: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.
God's men are absorbed in Lord God's Name and they have broken away the pangs and the fear of birth and death.
Y5B4: They have obtained the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they obtain great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||
They have obtained the imperishable Supreme Lord God, and great honour is theirs in the various regions and universes.
KLQQ: I am poor and meek, God, but I am Yours! Save me, please save me, O Greatest of the Great!
I am poor and humble, and I am Yours, O Lord God. Save me, save me, O you greatest of great.
ESGU: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||8||22||60||
The Name is slave Nanak's sustenance and support, and by god's Name I enjoy peace.
JUN7: Within this body-fortress is the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King, but the stubborn ones do not find the taste.
In this body castle is the Lord God, the King. But the shameless fellow obtains not His relish.
VJSZ: When the Lord, Merciful to the meek, showed His Mercy, I found and tasted it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
When God, compassionate to the poor, showed mercy, I tasted and saw this relish, through the Divine Guru 's word.
VBL0: Lovingly focused upon the Guru, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has become sweet to me. ||1||Pause||
My Master, by enshrining affection for the Guru, singing the praises of God has become sweet to me. Pause.
1NEV: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who are committed to the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, meet the Lord.
God is inaccessible, incomprehensible, and transcendent. By attachment with Satguru, the intercessor, He is met.
T9EG: Those whose hearts are pleased with the Guru's Teachings - the Lord's Presence is revealed to them. ||2||
They, to whose heart Guru's word is pleasing, to them the viand of God, s Name is served.
L61J: The hearts of the self-willed manmukhs are hard and cruel; their inner beings are dark.
The heart of the mind-ward is very tyrannical. His interior is pitch dark.
VH8N: Even if the poisonous snake is fed large amounts of milk, it will still yield only poison. ||3||
If we feed a serpent upon much milk, on investigation, only poison shall come out of it.
TQBE: O Lord God, please unite me with the Holy Guru, so that I might joyfully grind and eat the Shabad.
My Lord Master, unite me with the Guru-saint, that, with my mouth, I may grind and eat, (lovingly sing) Gurbani as joy 's spell to destroy serpent 's venom.
54FB: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Guru; in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the bitter becomes sweet. ||4||9||23||61||
Servant Nanak, is Guru 's servant and slave. By associating with the saints society the bitter becomes sweet.
LM8P: For the sake of the Lord, Har, Har, I have sold my body to the Perfect Guru.
For the sake of the Lord Master, I have sold off my body to the Perfect Guru.
T9RE: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. A very blessed and fortunate destiny is recorded upon my forehead. ||1||
The beneficent True Guru has implanted God 's Name within me. On my face and forehead, very auspicious destiny is recorded.
JCFY: Through the Guru's Teachings, I am lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
By Guru 's gospel, man comes to embrace affection for the Lord God. Pause.

HZHK: The All-pervading Sovereign Lord King is contained in each and every heart. Through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am lovingly centered on the Lord.
In every heart the sovereign Pervading Lord is contained. Through the Guru 's word and the Guru love for Him in contracted.
P6WG: Cutting my mind and body into pieces, I offer them to my Guru. The Guru's Teachings have dispelled my doubt and fear. ||2||
Cutting my mind and body into pieces, I offer them to my Guru. By Guru 's word, my doubt and dread depart.
C0V6: In the darkness, the Guru has lit the lamp of the Guru's wisdom; I am lovingly focused on the Lord.
When the Guru comes and kindles the lamp of the great Divine-Knowledge in darkness mortal 's attention is fixed on God.
HT9E: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, and my mind has been awakened; within the home of my inner being, I have found the genuine article. ||3||
The darkness of ignorance altogether eliminated, the mind is awakened, and finds the commodity within its home.
BA45: The vicious hunters, the faithless cynics, are hunted down by the Messenger of Death.
Those who are materialists perverse hunters to them the Death 's courier begins to stalk.
TQM1: They have not sold their heads to the True Guru; those wretched, unfortunate ones continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||4||
They have not sold their head to the True Guru. Those unfortunate ones continue coming and going.
GGCJ: Hear my prayer, O God, my Lord and Master: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord God.
Listen You to my supplication O Lord Master. I ask for the sanctuary of the Lord God.
DXMQ: Servant Nanak's honor and respect is the Guru; he has sold his head to the True Guru. ||5||10||24||62||
Slave Nanak 's respect and honour is the Guru. He has sold off his head to the True Guru.
8ET6: I am egotistical and conceited, and my intellect is ignorant. Meeting the Guru, my selfishness and conceit have been abolished.
I am proud, and haughty is my darkened intellect. By meeting the Guru, I have affected my self-conceit.
MQJ5: The illness of egotism is gone, and I have found peace. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||
The ailment of ego is gone, and I have procured peace. Blessed blessed is Guru-God, the King.
HJ5A: I have found the Lord, through the Teachings of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
Through Guru 's hymns, I have obtained the Pervading Lord God. Pause.
0D7H: My heart is filled with love for the Sovereign Lord King; the Guru has shown me the path and the way to find Him.
Within my mind is the love of the Sovereign Lord. The Guru has shown me the path and way to Him.
T9JJ: My soul and body all belong to the Guru; I was separated, and He has led me into the Lord's Embrace. ||2||
My soul and body are all at the disposal of the True Guru, who has caused me, the separated one, to embrace God.
4UVC: Deep within myself, I would love to see the Lord; the Guru has inspired me to see Him within my heart.
Within me is the love to see the Lord. The Guru caused me to see Him close to (in) my mind.
MEMM: Within my mind, intuitive peace and bliss have arisen; I have sold myself to the Guru. ||3||
Within my mind is peace and pleasure, I, myself am a sell off to the Guru,
HY2X: I am a sinner - I have committed so many sins; I am a villainous, thieving thief.
I have perpetrated many wicked deeds and sins. Becoming a villainous thief I have thieved.
S5R4: Now, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary; preserve my honor, Lord, as it pleases Your Will. ||4||11||25||63||
Nanak, now has sought God 's shelter. By Yours pleasure, O God, preserve my honour.
603E: Through the Guru's Teachings, the unstruck music resounds; through the Guru's Teachings, the mind sings.
By Guru's gospel, resounds the unstruck-music. By Guru 's gospel, the mind sings the Lord 's praises.
E00E: By great good fortune, I received the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has led me to love the Lord. ||1||
By very good luck, I had the Guru 's vision. Hail; hail to the Guru, who has made bear love to God.
XN05: The Gurmukh is lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The pious person enshrines affection for God. Pause.
GFAL: My Lord and Master is the Perfect True Guru. My mind works to serve the Guru.
My Master, the True Guru is perfect. My soul performs Guru 's service.
DGHT: I massage and wash the Feet of the Guru, who recites the Sermon of the Lord. ||2||
I rub, shampoo and wash the feet of the Guru who reads out to me the gospel of the Lord God.
ABPN: The Teachings of the Guru are in my heart; the Lord is the Source of nectar. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Within my mind is Guru 's instruction and the Lord, the Home of elixir. My tongue sings God 's praises.
JT36: My mind is immersed in, and drenched with the Lord's essence. Fulfilled with the Lord's Love, I shall never feel hunger again. ||3||
Immersed in love, my mind is satiated with God 's Nectar and afterwards it feels not hunger again.
9Q9M: People try all sorts of things, but without the Lord's Mercy, His Name is not obtained.
Though one may make varied and many efforts, yet without Lord 's mercy, he receives not the Name.
RDKA: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, he has enshrined the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||26||64||
To slave Nanak, God has shown mercy and by Guru 's instruction and advice, he has enshrined God 's Name in his mind.
S1J5: O my soul, as Gurmukh, do this deed: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
By Guru 's grace, O my soul, do you the deed of repeating God 's Name.
NRJG: Make that teaching your mother, that it may teach you to keep the Lord's Name in your mouth.
My soul, make that intellect your mother, which gives you the advice to keep the Lord 's Name in your mouth.
61E3: Let contentment be your father; the Guru is the Primal Being, beyond birth or incarnation.
Make contentment your father and the Guru your unborn Lord.

2ABM: By great good fortune, you shall meet with the Lord. ||1||
O man of good fortune, unite with the Pervading Lord.
ZLBS: I have met the Guru, the Yogi, the Primal Being; I am delighted with His Love.
I have met Guru - God, the yogi and revel in his joy.
PZ0X: The Guru is imbued with the Love of the Lord; He dwells forever in Nirvaanaa.
The Guru is imbued with God 's love and is ever immaculate,
S6P5: By great good fortune, I met the most accomplished and all-knowing Lord.
By the greatest good fortune, I have met the Accomplished and Omniscient Lord.
ERCW: My mind and body are drenched in the Love of the Lord. ||2||
My soul and body are saturated with God 's love.
6G3G: Come, O Saints - let's meet together and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Come saints, let us meet together and repeat the Lord 's Name.
SJQH: In the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, let's earn the lasting profit of the Naam.
In the society of the righteous, let us ever, earn the profit of Master 's Name.
DZGN: Let's serve the Saints, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.
By performing the service of the pious person, let us put Nectar in our mouth.
P0J5: By one's karma and pre-ordained destiny, they are met. ||3||
One meets the Saint Guru, if such destiny is pre-ordained by the Primal Lord.
EMHQ: In the month of Saawan, the clouds of Ambrosial Nectar hang over the world.
In the mouth of Sawan, the world is over-cast with the cloud of the Name - Nectar.
EKBA: The peacock of the mind chirps, and receives the Word of the Shabad, in its mouth;
By tasting the Name - Nectar, my mind 's pea - cock has begun to chirp
L9R3: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord rains down, and the Sovereign Lord King is met.
The Godly Nectar rains and God the King is met,
SW3E: Servant Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||1||27||65||
Servant Nanak is imbued with the Lord 's love.
P8NX: Come, O sisters - let's make virtue our charms.
Come fellow - maid, let us make virtues our charms.
HT09: Let's join the Saints, and enjoy the pleasure of the Lord's Love.
Meeting the pious person, let us enjoy the peace and pleasure of Lord 's love.
MAL0: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom burns steadily in my mind.
The lamp of the Guru - given Divine - Knowledge, ever, remains burning within my mind.
4QT7: The Lord, being pleased and moved by pity, has led me to meet Him. ||1||
Being mightily pleased and moved with pity the Master has met me.
4EUG: My mind and body are filled with love for my Darling Lord.
Within my mind and body love of the darling God is enshrined.
G3KS: The True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, has united me with my Friend.
Satguru, the intercessor, has united me with my Friend.
NNNA: I offer my mind to the Guru, who has led me to meet my God.
I tender my mind to the Guru -saint, who causes me to meet my Master.
34SB: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||
To God I am ever a sacrifice.
ZYJ4: Dwell, O my Beloved, dwell, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, show mercy to me and come to dwell within my mind.
Dwell my Darling; dwell O Lord of Universe, O God, show mercy and do dwell witting my mind.
V0LD: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O my Lord of the Universe; I am transfixed with ecstasy, gazing upon the Perfect Guru.
O my Master, I have obtained my heart desired boons and am transported by beholding the Perfect Guru.
4U79: The happy soul-brides receive the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; night and day, their minds are blissful and happy.
The happy, brides receive God 's Name, O my Lord, and in supreme bliss, night and day, remain happy in their mind.
CKAR: By great good fortune, the Lord is found, O my Lord of the Universe; earning profit continually, the mind laughs with joy. ||3||
Through great good luck, God is obtained, O my Lord and by ever, earning profit man remains laughing with joy.
723A: The Lord Himself creates, and the Lord Himself beholds; the Lord Himself assigns all to their tasks.
God Himself creates, God Himself beholds and God Himself assigns work to the beings.
BB1N: Some partake of the bounty of the Lord's favor, which never runs out, while others receive only a handful.
Some partake of Lord 's bounties, which suffer no deficiency and some receive but a handful of corn.
R26N: Some sit upon thrones as kings, and enjoy constant pleasures, while others must beg for charity.
Some sit on throne as kings and are, ever, happy and some You causest to beg for aims.
CPRC: The Word of the Shabad is pervading in everyone, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||4||2||28||66||
My Master of the world, everywhere your order alone prevails. Servant Nanak meditates on Your Name.
EEPM: From within my mind, from within my mind, O my Lord of the Universe, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord, from within my mind.
From within, my mind, from within my mind, O my Master, from within my mind, I am imbued with God 's love.
Y9YN: The Lord's Love is with me, but it cannot be seen, O my Lord of the Universe; the Perfect Guru has led me to see the unseen.
Beloved God is with me, but He cannot be seen, O my Lord. The Perfect Guru, has shown me the Invisible One.
FRFP: He has revealed the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Lord of the Universe; all poverty and pain have departed.
Lord God 's Name is revealed to me, O my Master and all poverty and pain have departed.
LGL7: I have obtained the supreme status of the Lord, O my Lord of the Universe; by great good fortune, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||1||
I have obtained the exalted status, O my Lord God. Through the greatest good - fortune, I am absorbed in God 's Name.
M9KC: With his eyes, O my Beloved, with his eyes, O my Lord of the Universe - has anyone ever seen the Lord God with his eyes?
With his eyes, my Beloved, with his eyes my Master has any one seen with his eyes my Lord God.
KXKH: My mind and body are sad and depressed, O my Lord of the Universe; without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is withering away.
My soul and body are greatly sad in separation, O my world Lord. Without God (the Spouse) the bride is withering away.

QN44: Meeting the Saints, O my Lord of the Universe, I have found my Lord God, my Companion, my Best Friend.
On meeting the saintly persons O my God I have found my Lord Master, the Friends and Comrade.
D4PD: The Lord, the Life of the World, has come to meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. The night of my life now passes in peace. ||2||
God the Life of the world has come and met me O my master and my night now passes in peace.
H0J4: O Saints, unite me with my Lord God, my Best Friend; my mind and body are hungry for Him.
O saints unite me with my Lord God, the Friend. My soul and body hunger for Him.
VRDA: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved; deep within, I feel the pain of separation from the Lord.
I cannot live without seeing my Beloved. Within my mind is the pang of separation from God.
5EEW: The Sovereign Lord King is my Beloved, my Best Friend. Through the Guru, I have met Him, and my mind has been rejuvenated.
The sovereign Lord is my Darling Friend. The Guru has caused me to meet Him and my soul is regenerated.
Q01Q: The hopes of my mind and body have been fulfilled, O my Lord of the Universe; meeting the Lord, my mind vibrates with joy. ||3||
The aspirations of my mind and body are fulfilled, O my World Master. My soul is congratulated on meeting God.
UEKK: A sacrifice, O my Lord of the Universe, a sacrifice, O my Beloved; I am forever a sacrifice to You.
A sacrifice, my World - Lord, a sacrifice, my Beloved, I am ever a sacrifice to You.
JWRD: My mind and body are filled with love for my Husband Lord; O my Lord of the Universe, please preserve my assets.
In my mind and body is the love of my Beloved Spouse. O my Lord, preserve my capital, O God.
XUGQ: Unite me with the True Guru, Your Advisor, O my Lord of the Universe; through His guidance, He shall lead me to the Lord.
O my Lord, unite me with Satguru, the counsel, who through his guidance, shall cause me to meet God.
8RAL: I have obtained the Lord's Name, by Your Mercy, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||29||67||
Through Yours mercy, O my World - Lord. I have obtained God 's Name. Slave Nanak has entered Your sanctuary.
WBQ3: Playful is my Lord of the Universe; playful is my Beloved. My Lord God is wondrous and playful.
Sportive, my Master, sportive my Beloved, sportive is my Lord God.
ZRS3: The Lord Himself created Krishna, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is the milkmaids who seek Him.
God of himself creates Krishna, O my World -Lord, and God himself becomes milkmaid, the seeker.
XMDJ: The Lord Himself enjoys every heart, O my Lord of the Universe; He Himself is the Ravisher and the Enjoyer.
God of himself enjoys every heart, O my Lord, and He himself is the Relisher and Enjoyer.
H397: The Lord is All-knowing - He cannot be fooled, O my Lord of the Universe. He is the True Guru, the Yogi. ||1||
The Lord is wise and infallible. He himself is the true Guru, in union with him, O my World-Lord.
QWBR: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself plays in so many ways!
O My Lord God of himself creates the world and Himself plays in many a way.
5ZMR: Some enjoy enjoyments, O my Lord of the Universe, while others wander around naked, the poorest of the poor.
O My Lord! Some He causes to enjoy dainties and some becoming poorest of the poor wander about all-naked,
D8V1: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord gives His gifts to all who beg for them.
O my Lord! God himself makes the world and gives alms to all, who beg of Him.
1SJ0: His devotees have the Support of the Naam, O my Lord of the Universe; they beg for the sublime sermon of the Lord. ||2||
The saints have the support of the Name, O my Lord. They ask for, only, the exalted Divine gospel of Lord God.
1R73: The Lord Himself inspires His devotees to worship Him, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord fulfills the desires of the minds of His devotees.
God, of himself makes the saints perform His worship, O my Lord, and fulfills the mind's desires of His saints.
LQG5: He Himself is permeating and pervading the waters and the lands, O my Lord of the Universe; He is All-pervading - He is not far away.
The Lord himself is contained in water and land, O my master. He is all-pervading and is not far-off.
U8XH: The Lord Himself is within the self, and outside as well, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is fully pervading everywhere.
Within and without the Lord Himself is, O my Master. God of Himself is completely occupying all the places.
XGDZ: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is diffused everywhere, O my Lord of the Universe. The Lord Himself beholds all; His Immanent Presence is pervading everywhere. ||3||
His Pervading Soul, the Lord has diffused throughout, O my Master. God Himself is beholding all, near at hand.
H6X0: O Lord, the music of the praanic wind is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; as the Lord Himself plays this music, so does it vibrate and resound.
O God, my Lord, within the creatures is the music of the air. As God Himself plays the tune so dose it resound.
LF9L: O Lord, the treasure of the Naam is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord God is revealed.
O God, my Lord, within us is the Name treasure. By Guru's instruction the Lord God becomes manifest.
G9SS: He Himself leads us to enter His Sanctuary, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord preserves the honor of His devotees.
O my Lord! God Himself causes man to enter His sanctuary and saves the honour of the devoted persons.

GBV3: By great good fortune, one joins the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, O my Lord of the Universe; O servant Nanak, through the Naam, one's affairs are resolved. ||4||4||30||68||
O my Master! Through very good fortune, man meets society of saints and O slave Nanak, with God's Name his affairs are adjusted.
3VBM: The Lord has implanted a longing for the Lord's Name within me.
For God's Name and God, I have developed love.
SA9X: I have met the Lord God, my Best Friend, and I have found peace.
When I meet my Lord God, the Friend, I obtain peace.
PFNH: Beholding my Lord God, I live, O my mother.
By beholding Lord Master, I sustain life, O my mother.
BEZU: The Lord's Name is my Friend and Brother. ||1||
God's Name is my friend and brother.
6NJL: O Dear Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord God.
O venerable Saints, sing the praises of my Lord God.
MNHB: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O very fortunate ones.
O you very fortunate ones, through the Guru meditate on God's Name.
FCZH: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my soul and my breath of life.
Lord God's Name, and God, are my life and soul.
YL5P: I shall never again have to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
By repeating the Name, I shall not, afterwards again, cross the terrible ocean.
VG2F: How shall I behold my Lord God? My mind and body yearn for Him.
How shall I see the Lord Master; the yearning of my soul and body?
NF1D: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints; my mind is in love with Him.
Unite me with God, O honourable saints, my soul bears Him love,
3ASH: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the Sovereign Lord, my Beloved.
By the Guru's gospel, God, the Beloved King is obtained.
8HW0: O very fortunate ones, chant the Name of the Lord. ||3||
O very fortunate mortal, do you repeat the Name of the Lord.
JWUC: Within my mind and body, there is such a great longing for God, the Lord of the Universe.
Within my mind and body is the great longing for the Lord Master.
9MK7: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints. God, the Lord of the Universe, is so close to me.
O Saints, unite me with the Lord Master, who is very near to me.
J7Y6: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Naam is always revealed;
By the True Guru's instruction, God's Name is, ever, manifest to me.
UWZZ: the desires of servant Nanak's mind have been fulfilled. ||4||5||31||69||
The desire of slave Nanak's heart is fulfilled.
ZHV1: If I receive my Love, the Naam, then I live.
If I receive my favourite Name, then alone can I live.
SPYL: In the temple of the mind, is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, we drink it in.
In the mind is God's elixir. By Guru's gospel I shall quaff it.
SCAX: My mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. I continually drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.
My soul is tinged with God's love. God's Nectar, do I, ever drink.
HWMT: I have found the Lord within my mind, and so I live. ||1||
The Lord I have obtained within my mind, so do I live.
HXZH: The arrow of the Lord's Love has pierced by mind and body.
The arrow of God's love has pierced my soul and body.
RHNU: The Lord, the Primal Being, is All-knowing; He is my Beloved and my Best Friend.
The Lord Master is my Wise, and beloved Intimate.
J0RD: The Saintly Guru has united me with the All-knowing and All-seeing Lord.
The Guru saint has united me with the Omniscient, and All-seeing Lord.
162F: I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
I am devoted to the Name of God.
EZXF: I seek my Lord, Har, Har, my Intimate, my Best Friend.
I inquire about the Lord Master, my intimate God, the friend.
